title: The Whispering Ferry of Siltwater
prose:
1. Speak with Kaelen the Ferryman at Siltwater Crossing.
The rushing waters of the Siltwater River bar the path forward, and only Kaelen's sturdy raft can brave the current. However, the old ferryman refuses to budge until his steep toll is paid in full.

2. Retrieve the Sunken Silver from the Drowned Grotto.
Kaelen demands a rare coin pouch lost to the river beasts in the nearby Drowned Grotto. Brave the flooded caverns and wrest the Sunken Silver from the clutches of the Mire-Gnasher.

3. Deliver the toll to Kaelen and board the raft.
With the heavy pouch of Sunken Silver in hand, return to Siltwater Crossing before the tide rises. Present the toll to Kaelen to secure safe passage to the eastern shore.
